newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - July 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - July 10.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Taiwan tourists evacuated from Cambodia following civil war.
Ruling Nationalist Party, opposition Democratic Progressive Party continue negotiation on constitutional amendments.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Taiwan rents planes from Vietnam to evacuate tourists from Cambodia.
National assembly members support "absolute majority" system for presidential elections, requiring winner to have more than 50 percent of total votes.
LIBERTY TIMES - Democratic Progressive Party chairman Hsu Hsin-liang says abolishing provincial government does not signify declaration of independence for Taiwan.
Taiwan investors and tourists in Cambodia complain of inadequate assistance from Taiwan representative office.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Huge microchip projects by Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co and United Microelectronics trigger demand for capital, human resources.
Former Taiwan Semiconductor president Donald Brooks hired as senior executive by rival United Micro.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Taiwan passes on T$10 billion treasury bill auction.
